p: Bellegrove Road is the main shopping road through Welling, with Welling station on the line between London and Dartford a short walk away. MERKUR is an 18+ venue, strictly for adults.

Danson Park is the area's top spot, with a big boating lake, gardens and Danson House, a Georgian villa you can look round. Hall Place in Bexley is a Tudor house with lovely gardens and topiary, and well worth a visit. Welling United play at Park View Road if you fancy a bit of non-league football.
